name: Arcturus Defense Solutions Graviton Shield Projector GSP-1 'Aegis'
description: An experimental defensive system that projects a localized gravity distortion field in a 3-meter hemisphere around the emitter, deflecting incoming projectiles by altering their trajectory through gravitational lensing. The GSP-1 does not stop bullets — it bends them, causing rounds to curve away from the protected zone with increasing deflection based on proximity to the emitter. The field is effective against ballistic projectiles and slow-moving ordnance but has minimal effect on directed energy weapons, which travel too fast for gravitational deflection at this scale. The system consumes enormous power and can only maintain the field for 12 seconds before requiring a 90-second recharge.
specifications:
field radius: 3-meter hemisphere
deflection effect: Ballistic trajectory deviation up to 30 degrees
field duration: 12 seconds maximum
recharge time: 90 seconds
power source: Dedicated fusion micro-cell
weight: 35 kg emitter with power unit
effectiveness: High against ballistics, minimal against directed energy
prototypes deployed: Estimated 8 units in field testing
story_hooks: A corporate VIP survived an assassination attempt when every round fired at their vehicle curved away — footage suggests graviton shielding, but no GSP-1 was visible in the wreckage.
An Arcturus field test of the GSP-1 went wrong when the gravity distortion field collapsed asymmetrically, launching deflected rounds into a nearby civilian area.

physical_description.visual_profile: A brutalist, angular apparatus resembling a mounted cannon crossed with a particle accelerator. The emitter sits atop a heavily braced pedestal base, with a wide, flared muzzle that terminates in a ribbed aperture. The overall impression is industrial, deliberately intimidating — built for power rather than elegance.
physical_description.dimensions: Emitter head: 48cm long, 32cm diameter at muzzle. Pedestal mount: 110cm height total. Power unit module: 38cm × 28cm × 24cm.
physical_description.weight_description: Brutally hefty. The 35kg mass is distributed low through the stabilized base, but the emitter itself feels dense and front-heavy. Designed for fixed mounting or braced deployment — not shoulder-fired.
physical_description.primary_material: Tungsten-alloy frame with carbon-composite bracing struts. The emitter core is shielded in layered steel and ceramic heat-dispersion tiles.
physical_description.finish: Industrial matte black with exposed brushed steel reinforcement bands. Thermal tiles on the muzzle show scorch marks and subtle heat discoloration from fusion-cell proximity.
physical_description.color_scheme: Charcoal black primary with steel gray accents. Warning stripe (sodium yellow) wraps the mid-section where the power coupling interfaces. Internal ribbing hints at deep blue coolant lines visible through vented sections.
physical_description.grip_texture: Mounting points feature rubberized polymer grips for repositioning. Control panel surfaces are bare anodized aluminum — utilitarian, slightly grippy from age and fingerprint oil.
distinctive_features: Radial ribbing around the muzzle aperture (gravity field modulation channels)
Three vertical coolant vent stacks running the length of the emitter
Recessed pressure-release valve assembly (glowing amber indicator when charged)
Mechanical safety lever (bright red, oversized for gloved operation)
Fusion micro-cell module visible through reinforced viewport — faint blue luminescence when primed
Scorched thermal discoloration radiating from the muzzle in concentric rings
Etched circuit tracery visible on the steel bands (gravity field distribution geometry)
Heavy cable junction with military-grade connectors at the base
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Ironside Armaments stamp (block serif, laser-etched) on the left side of the pedestal. Serial plate affixed below: 'GSP-1 ARCTURUS DEFENSE SOLUTIONS — PROTOTYPE XX / AUTHORIZED MILITARY TESTING ONLY.' Smaller warning placard in four languages (EN, Mandarin, Hindi, Portuguese) below the control panel.
physical_description.condition_typical: Field-tested but maintained. Light scoring on the ceramic tiles, minor cable fraying at the junction. The red safety lever shows micro-scratches from repeated use. Dust accumulation in the vent stacks suggests deployment in ungoverned zones (Tier 5 salvage environments).
